rules.description: Verify 2018 life expectancy (ujtdaag), 2017-Q4 labor force (ulouknf), 2017 census/employment/graduates/infant mortality (behvqtc, bluhqme, lxoyale, mptocre, pqpump, szfufmb, zkjifzd, zpdksog), and 2015-2016 education enrollment/teachers (txbrrac, wcssteb, wtxyghf) StatVars meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) AS MinDate, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|CriminalIncidents$|Establishment_|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital|Incident_|MedicalConditionIncident_|MortalityEvent_Accident$)') AND NOT (StatVar = 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_|Count_Person_(CommoditySector|Employed|ProductiveSocialServicesSector|Resident)$|UnemploymentRate_Person)') OR (CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) < '2015' AND regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person($|_Unemployed(_Female|_Male)?$|_InLaborForce_(Female|Male)$|_(Female_|Male_)?Workers?$)')))
params.condition: CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^LifeExpectancy_Person_') THEN MaxDate >= '2018' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_(InLaborForce(_Female|_Male)?|(Female_|Male_)?Workers?|Unemployed(_Female|_Male)?(_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person_InLaborForce(_Female|_Male)?)?)$') THEN MaxDate >= '2017-12' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Teacher_PublicUniversityOrAlAzharUniversity', 'Count_Teacher_PrivateUniversity') THEN MaxDate >= '2015' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Student|Teacher)_|dc/7hlfs8swh22v3$)') THEN MaxDate >= '2016' ELSE MaxDate >= '2017' END

rules.description: Verify 2014 health facilities/staff (cjczlcd), 2014 total fertility rate (viytqvf), and 2005-2014-09 socio-economic macro series (xovpotd) meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) AS MinDate, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_|Count_Person_(CommoditySector|Employed|ProductiveSocialServicesSector|Resident)$|UnemploymentRate_Person)') OR (CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) < '2015' AND regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person($|_Unemployed(_Female|_Male)?$|_InLaborForce_(Female|Male)$|_(Female_|Male_)?Workers?$)'))
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Person_CommoditySector', 'Count_Person_ProductiveSocialServicesSector') THEN MaxDate >= '2005' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_Person' THEN MaxDate >= '2011' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Amount_EconomicActivity_GrossDomesticProduction_|Count_Person_(Employed|Resident)$)') THEN MaxDate >= '2012' WHEN StatVar = 'FertilityRate_Person_Female' OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '_(HealthFacility|DoctorOccupation|NurseOccupation)$') THEN MaxDate >= '2014' ELSE MaxDate >= '2014-09' END

rules.description: Verify 2002-2011 health services, hospitals, beds, ambulance stations, youth centers, and traffic/medical incident series (actytif) meet their expected MaxDate boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS MaxDate FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|CriminalIncidents$|Establishment_|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital|Incident_|MedicalConditionIncident_|MortalityEvent_Accident$)')
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Count_MedicalConditionIncident_SportsGamesAccidents' THEN MaxDate >= '2002' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Incident_Other_AccidentDamage', 'Count_MedicalConditionIncident_ScorpionOrSnakeBites') THEN MaxDate >= '2004' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_CriminalIncidents' THEN MaxDate >= '2008' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Bed_|Establishment_SocialCareFacility$|HealthEstablishment_.*Hospital)') THEN MaxDate >= '2009' WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_Accident', 'Count_Incident_AccidentDamage', 'Count_Incident_TrafficAccident') OR regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(Incident_.*_(TrafficAccident|AccidentDamage)|MedicalConditionIncident_(Anaesthetics|Bleeding|Dislocation|Fracture|Hernia|InsectBites|LossOfConsciousness|Others|Suffocation|Wounds))$') THEN MaxDate >= '2010' ELSE MaxDate >= '2011' END

rules.description: Verify wcssteb primary school students and teachers exceed pre-primary (KG) totals to guard against upstream OpenDataForAfrica ID=1/ID=2 stage-label un-swapping.

params.query: SELECT pairs.PrimarySV, p.MinValue AS PrimaryMin, pairs.PrePrimarySV, pre.MaxValue AS PrePrimaryMax FROM (VALUES ('Count_Student_PrimarySchool', 'Count_Student_PrePrimarySchool'), ('dc/7hlfs8swh22v3', 'Count_Teacher_PrePrimarySchool')) AS pairs(PrimarySV, PrePrimarySV) LEFT JOIN stats p ON p.StatVar = pairs.PrimarySV LEFT JOIN stats pre ON pre.StatVar = pairs.PrePrimarySV WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_Student_PrimarySchool', 'Count_Student_PrePrimarySchool', 'dc/7hlfs8swh22v3', 'Count_Teacher_PrePrimarySchool'))
params.condition: PrimaryMin IS NOT NULL AND PrePrimaryMax IS NOT NULL AND PrimaryMin > PrePrimaryMax
